svg.text: Left: drawing tools. Top: ticker / timeframe / indicators. Right: launch rail and contextual drawer. Chart retained in every frame.
Run bundle viewer: future launcher placeholder only, disabled; no V1 viewer or external import is introduced.
Both Bid and Ask selected. Each UTC bucket pairs a filled Bid candle on the left and a hollow Ask candle on the right, with two corresponding volume bars. The header and
inspector expose separately labelled Bid and Ask OHLCV. Values and bars are schematic placeholders, not validated market data. Bullish candles use light shades and
bearish candles dark shades on filled bodies and hollow borders/wicks. Calculation-side study selection remains independent.
References: E01 chart shell; E07 settings; A29 Go to; A31/A32 floating replay capsule. Settings, Go to and replay may float. Other tasks dock; state/target/boundary stay
